target_customer: Software developers and teams running AI coding agents who need persistent cloud machines
problem: Coding agents stop when a laptop closes and local setups are hard to share. Prized gives each developer a persistent cloud Linux machine that syncs to a local folder.
business_model: Subscription plans from $10 to $1,000 per month plus usage billing for sandboxes (per the company site)
product_category: Cloud development environments and agent sandboxes

founders.name: Hudson Griffith
previous_startups: Gander (YC F24, acquired by Archer Aviation), as first engineer

founders.name: Marinos Eliades
previous_startups: Gander (YC F24, acquired by Archer Aviation), as engineer
founders.background_notes: Served in the National Guard of Cyprus per YC page

competitors.name: E2B
competitors.what: Sandboxes for AI agent code execution
competitors.traction_then: Described as a default for many teams in comparison posts

competitors.name: Daytona
competitors.what: Dev environment and agent sandbox platform
competitors.funding_then: Seed funding announced earlier per its blog

competitors.name: Runloop
competitors.what: Cloud devboxes for AI coding agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Firecracker microVMs, two way file sync and port mirroring are well understood building blocks but need solid infrastructure work for a team of two.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded sandbox and devbox vendors exist and the building blocks are open source, so copying is fast.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Crowded category in 2026; no incumbent action against Prized reported.

market_need_then: Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex became mainstream and teams want them to keep running when a laptop closes. Several vendor comparison posts in 2026 show demand for agent sandboxes.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch in August 2026 with 97 upvotes per one source; the source dates conflict

brand_strength.rationale: Brand is minimal and the name does not signal the product; little coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Prized is a Summer 2026 YC company with no outcome yet. Both founders worked at Gander, which Archer Aviation acquired, but the devbox space is crowded and easy to copy, so winning will depend on developer experience and distribution. A YC launch page also frames it as an internal tool builder, so the positioning is unsettled.
notes: Unverified single source figures: Dealroom lists a $125K seed and one directory lists a $500K YC seed; neither is a company or press source. Prized.dev company site says only that it is backed by YC. A YC launch page titled 'prized lovable for internal tools' and Product Hunt copy describe an internal tools builder, which may be a different product or an earlier positioning; unresolved. Launch date conflicts (August 1 vs August 20, 2026). The competitor funding facts come from vendor posts not dated near the batch, so as_of is approximate. Archer Aviation acquisition of Gander comes from the YC page only. Completeness pass: seed of 500K dated 2026-06-30 recorded from Everydev (a single directory). Dealroom reports a 125K seed, so amounts conflict and the round rests on directories only.
